title: market.review.retracted v1
description: Consumed by CORE when MARKET withdraws a rating it previously reported. CORE marks the signal retracted rather than deleting or reversing it: the row keeps stating what was reported and gains the fact that it was withdrawn, and a withdrawn signal stops counting towards any derived standing. A retraction naming a review CORE never received, or one already withdrawn, is answered rather than refused.

review_reference.description: The same MARKET identifier the rating was reported under.

organization_id.description: The CORE tenant the signal belongs to.

reason.description: Why the rating was withdrawn. Required: a withdrawal nobody can explain is a withdrawal nobody can review.
